subject: science
concept: Observing that heating and cooling can change matter from one state to another (melting, freezing)
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Physical Science Disciplinary Core Ideas — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student observes an ice cube melting (or a simulation of it) and describes the change over time
exercise.pictorial: Student sequences pictures showing ice melting into water in the correct order
exercise.abstract: Student predicts what happens to a substance when heated or cooled

misconception_flags: believes the substance disappears rather than changing state

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
